prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-01 for page 15-E-02-long-form-feedback, state complete. Reference state: completed TOPIK long-form writing feedback with score 74/100, badges for problem type/count/submitted time, sentence-by-sentence correction attachment, detailed feedback categories, recommended learning, and bottom actions.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve left sidebar. Create a feedback workspace with a top score summary band, then a main two-column evaluation area: left manuscript/sentence correction stack with original struck-through and corrected line, right sticky evaluator rail with category scores and next actions. Bottom area includes recommended learning tiles and compact actions: rewrite, next problem, save, comparison report.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly SaaS UI, compact density, neutral analytical interface, clear hierarchy for long writing review, no marketing hero.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian neutral surfaces; Obsidian #09090b for primary action only. Use restrained green/amber only for score and correction semantics, no chromatic CTA set.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing. Dense feedback text must feel readable and structured.
Must preserve state signals: complete feedback state, visible score 74/100 or equivalent score summary, sentence-level corrections, detailed feedback categories, recommended learning, bottom action set.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud AI gradients, colorful primary buttons, decorative illustrations, heavy card shadows, over-rounded workspace cards.
